files_or_snippet: TokenStream.prototype.next / isWhitespace / isRadixInteger / isNumber / isName scanning routines
how_adapted: Acquired via browser (raw view, copy/paste). Converted to an ES class; removed strings, comments, named ops, brackets and option handling; tokens are {type,value,pos}; added uppercase 0X/0B and a punctuation scanner; errors throw CalcError with position. Parser (recursive descent with implicit multiplication), evaluator, angle modes, user functions, history and REPL were written new as glue.
